# jwt_decoded_token (Data Source)

Decodes a compact-serialized JWT into its header, claims, and signature. The signature is **not** verified: use this data source to read claims out of a token whose trust is already established by other means (TLS, mTLS, key-rotated upstream service).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Decode a JWT that was produced elsewhere into its header, claims,
# and signature so individual claim values can drive other Terraform
# resources.
data "jwt_decoded_token" "example" {
  token = var.upstream_jwt
}

variable "upstream_jwt" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

output "subject" {
  value = jsondecode(data.jwt_decoded_token.example.claims_json).sub
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `token` (String, Sensitive) The compact-serialized JWT to decode.

### Read-Only

- `algorithm` (String) Signing algorithm declared in the header `alg` claim.
- `claims_json` (String) JSON-encoded JWT claims payload.
- `header_json` (String) JSON-encoded JWT header (JOSE header).
- `signature_b64` (String) Base64url-encoded JWT signature (third segment).
